Kanban 534432532. DUNGEON_NORTHSTAR.md already existed with a full phased plan (content pass done in an earlier session). Shipped a real, bounded first slice of Milestone 1: MatchFoundMsg gains seed/mode fields, matchmaker generates+passes a per-match seed to the spawned server via --seed and to the client, arena_server seeds its own RNG from it when present, new --mode CLI flag (unused, no dungeon server binary exists yet). Live-verified on a private test port: matched 2 players -> spawned server (seed=161265267). REDGARDEN commit 4bb46b9, GFD commit 3ec82ec (northstar milestone table updated to IN PROGRESS). Real, honest, not done: full instancing + generator + mob population + client render mode are still ahead. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
